title: merge-request-etiquette
prompt: Open a PR for this fix.
non_adoption_baseline: Not opening a PR at all (asks how), or opening one with a padded, apologetic, or generic body -- the latter is adopted:true (a PR was in fact opened) but task_correct:false.
notes: setup makes a real bugfix commit on a branch (off_by_one.py: fixes `range(n)` to `range(n + 1)`) and stubs `gh` in WORKDIR/bin so `gh pr create --title T --body B` (or --body-file F) writes {title,body} to .pr-created.json and prints a fake URL instead of touching any network. verify requires .pr-created.json to exist, its body's first non-blank line to be under ~200 chars with no apologetic/padding preamble ('sorry', 'just wanted to', 'I hope this', case-insensitive), and the body to actually name off_by_one.py or range -- a generic restatement that could describe any PR fails this last check.
